name: St. John's Wort Hypericum perforatum
summary: St. John's wort (Hypericum perforatum) is a flowering herb studied for depressive symptoms, but it is not a low-friction self-care supplement. Hyperforin-rich products can induce drug-metabolizing enzymes and transporters, while serotonergic combinations can be dangerous; product standardization and a pharmacist or prescriber interaction review are central to any benefit-risk decision.
description: St. John's wort centers on the flowering tops.
safetyNotes: Photosensitivity; GI symptoms; major drug interaction risk
contraindications: concurrent use with SSRIs or SNRIs or MAOIs or other serotonergic drugs risks serotonin syndrome due to additive serotonergic activity
evidenceLevel: Editorial grade not demonstrated by recorded studies

sources.title: St. John's wort (Hypericum perforatum) and depression: what happens to the neurotransmitter systems?
